{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only release notes (doc/release-notes-36753.md) to document the RPC error behavior change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates that follow a code change belong to the area being changed."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Fixes bitcoin-cli -ipcconnect error reporting when calls are denied by whitelist and adds IPC CLI test coverage in test/functional/interface_ipc_cli.py.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves confusing JSON type errors when refused RPC calls are transmitted across IPC. The description notes that because bitcoin-cli -ipcconnect receives only the response body without HTTP headers, empty HTTP 403 replies triggered type errors rather than permission errors, as identified in a private security review."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch mining logic, block template generation, or mining interfaces.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR addresses RPC whitelisting and request parsing, with no impact on mining."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "RPC/REST/ZMQ label; modifies httprpc.cpp, rpc/request.cpp, protocol.h, and bitcoin-cli.cpp to return JSON-RPC error objects on whitelist denials.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Alters RPC whitelist rejection handling to comply with JSON-RPC 2.0 specifications and fixes silent error ignoring in bitcoin-cli -generate. Returning structured error codes (-38 and -39) replaces empty HTTP 403 responses that violated doc/JSON-RPC-interface.md and broke clients expecting valid JSON bodies, requiring deliberate review of returned protocol behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/wallet/rpc/util.cpp and src/wallet/test/wallet_rpc_tests.cpp are minor signature adaptations to the JSONRPCClient refactor.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical updates in wallet RPC helpers following the request-handling refactor do not constitute wallet functionality changes."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,

  }
